text_to_image_prompt: One compact tropical oceanfront flat-roof white villa to the right of a single long rectangular cyan infinity pool. Ocean to left; circular sunken lounge with cream cushions and round fire bowl at far short end; narrow stone paths; straight floating wood exterior stair at near end of villa; small wooden bar with three wicker stools at near-right. Teak roof has white daybed, brass telescope, slim dark/glass railings. No people, second pool or extra wings. Vertical night establishing shot from pool deck, cyan pool foreground, white villa and illuminated stairs on left, palms, firelit circular lounge in distance, moon and sea beyond, strings of warm bulbs, no people.
